title: Seasonal and anomaly chlorophyll–wind association
query: Using monthly MODIS-Aqua chlorophyll and NOAA blended scalar wind speed over 104–122 E, 1–25 N for 2003–2012, construct matched area-weighted South China Sea time series. Compare the association in the raw records with that after removal of calendar-month climatologies, and check sensitivity to omitting the first and last year. Show the series and association estimates; a full EEMD decomposition is not required. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
